romanized_text:
dilli ke ek purane mohalle men char dost ek sath badae hue the rohan, mir, kabir aur anany. charon ek hi kleja men padhate the aur aksar sham ko mir ke ghar ki chat para milate the. us chat se pure shahar ki roshani dikhai deti thi, aur vahin baithakar unhonne apane sabase badae sapane dekhe the.

ek sham rohan bahut utsahit hokar chat para pahunch. usake hath men usak laipatpa tha. yara, mainne ek aip k aidiy socha hai, usane kaha. yaha logon ko unake shahar ke chote dukanadaron se sidhe jodaeg. agar yaha chal gaya to ham sab ki jaindagi badal jaegi. kabir ne alas se angadaai li aur bol, phira se koi naya plan? pichali bar bhi tune ais hi kaha tha.

mir ne rohan k aidiy dhyan se sun. vaha hamesh se samuh ki sabase vyavaharik sadasy thi. aidiya to achch hai, usane kaha, lekina hamen ek pratiyogit chahie jahan ham ise ban saken. agale mahine shahar men ek badaa haikathna ho rah hai. jitane vali tim ko pachas hajaar rupaye aur ek badai kanpani se mulakaat milegi.

anany, jo ab tak chup thi, achanak khadai ho gai. main dijaain sanbhal sakati hun, usane atmavishvas se kaha. lekina hamare pas sirpha tin haphate hain. hamen abhi se kam shuru karan hog, varan ham kabhi taiyar nahin ho paenge. charon ne usi rat tay kara liya ki ve milakar haikathna men bhag lenge.

agale din rohan apane dadaji se milane baithak men gaya. dadaji ek sevanivritta adhyapak the aur ghar ke sabase bujaurg sadasy the. dadaji, main apane doston ke sath ek pratiyogit men bhag le rah hun, rohan ne adar se kaha. dadaji muskurae aur bole, bahuta achch, bet. parishram kabhi vyarth nahin jata. para yad rakhan, imanadari sabase badai punji hai. apane sathiyon k sath kabhi mat chodana.

kam shuru hua, lekin jaldi hi mushkilen bhi ane lagin. ek rat kod bara-bara tut rah tha aur kuch bhi thik nahin chal rah tha. rohan bahut pareshan ho gaya. yaha kam nahin kara raha, usane jhunjhalakar kaha. hamane itane din barbad kara die aur ab bhi kuch taiyar nahin hai. mujhe lagat hai ham har jaenge. kabir, jo hamesh shant rahat tha, bol, thodaa sans le. ghabarane se kuch nahin hog. eka-eka karake thik karate hain.

mir ne rat bhar baithakar samasy dhundhi aur akhairakar galati pakada li. mila gaya! usane khushi se chillakar kaha. eka choti si galati thi, bas ek lain men. ab sab thik chaleg. subah hote-hote aip k pahala hiss kam karane lag. charon ki thakan ek pal men gayab ho gai aur unake chehare para nai ummid a gai.

haikathna se tin din pahale ek aur musibat ai. jis dukan ke det para ve bharos kara rahe the, usake malik ne achanak man kara diya. anany bahut tanav men a gai. aba ham kya karenge? usane ghabarakar puch. bina asali det ke hamar aip adhur raheg. samay bhi nahin bach. rohan ne gahari sans li aur kaha, hama nae dukanadaron se khud bat karenge. jaldi karo, hamare pas eka-eka ghant kimati hai.

charon dost us din pure bajaar men ghume. unhonne darjanon chote dukanadaron se bat ki aur apan aidiy samajhay. shuruat men kai logon ne man kiya, lekin dhire-dhire kuch dukanadar rajai ho gae. ek bujaurg kiran vyapari ne kaha, agara tum bachche sach men hamari madad karan chahate ho, to main tumhare sath hun. sham tak unake pas pahale se bhi behatar det ikatth ho gaya tha.

haikathna k din a gaya. badaa hla saikadaon pratiyogiyon se bhar tha. manch para ek kathor dikhane vali nirnayak baithi thin prophaesar sharm, jo apani sakhati ke lie mashahur thin. rohan bahut narvas tha. agara main manch para atak gaya to? usane dhire se kaha. mir ne usak kandh thapathapay aur boli, tu yaha kara sakat hai. ham sab tere sath hain. bas sach bol, baki apane ap ho jaeg.

rohan ne manch para jakar apani prastuti di. pahale to usaki avaja kanp rahi thi, lekin jaise-jaise vaha apane aip ke bare men batat gaya, usak atmavishvas laut ay. usane batay ki kaise yaha aip chote dukanadaron ki jaindagi badal sakat hai. pura hla dhyan se sun rah tha. prastuti ke ant men taliyon ki gunj uthi.

nirnayak prophaesar sharm ne kuch kathin saval puche. tumhare pas asali upayogakart kahan hain? unhonne ganbhirat se puch. aura agar badai kanpaniyan yahi kam karane lagen to tumhar kya hog? rohan ne shanti se har saval k javab diya aur bajaar men ikatth kie asali dukanadaron ke bare men batay. prophaesar sharm ne pahali bar halki muskan di aur kaha, tumhari taiyari prabhavashali hai.

parinam ki ghoshan k samay ay. hla men sannat ch gaya. jab prophaesar sharm ne vijet ke rup men rohan ki tim k nam pukar, to charon dost khushi se uchal padae. hama jit gae! anany chillai. kabir, jo kabhi utsahit nahin hota tha, aj jaor se hans rah tha. yakina nahin ho rah, hamane sach men kara dikhaya, usane kaha.

us rat charon dost phir usi chat para ikatth hue, jahan se yaha saphara shuru hua tha. pachas hajaar k inam unake samane rakh tha, para usase badai chija thi unak apasi bharos. rohan ne kaha, yaha jit akele kisi ki nahin hai. yaha ham charon ki hai. mir ne muskurakar kaha, aura yaha to bas shuruat hai.

agali subah rohan ne apane dadaji ko puri kahani sunai. dadaji ne usak sir sahalay aur kaha, mujhe tum para garv hai, bet. para yad rakhan asali saphalat paise men nahin, balki un logon men hai jo kathin samay men tumhare sath khadae rahe. rohan ne us din samajh ki usane sirpha ek pratiyogit nahin jiti thi, balki jivan bhar k ek sabak bhi sikh tha.
